title: acre draws libsufr's key schemes, masked and unmasked, with the code's structure
body: libsufr's `build.rs` now splits key making into `Packing` and a `KeyScheme` trait with two implementations, `UnmaskedKeys` and `MaskedKeys`. The earlier PrefixEncoder figure used the old name `PrefixEncoder` and shows only the unmasked keys. The new figure is `figures/key-schemes.acre` in the acre checkout. Jack keeps it out of git, as a test case for improving acre. It shows how the types fit together, `Packing` once, both schemes on one text with a 24-character spaced seed mask, and how each orders ties and takes an LCP. Every field of `Packing`, `UnmaskedKeys` and `MaskedKeys` appears.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/cd2d1020
notes.text: examples/key-schemes.acre is written and renders. tmp-claude/2026-11-13-key-schemes/model.py checked every key, the masked key 0x6522ca65384c0000, care_bits, window_offset [6, 0] and pad_bits 16. prefix-encoder.acre is removed, and the formatter's idempotence test now reads key-schemes.acre. Not committed yet.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/cd2d1020
notes.text: Jack judged the reworked figure much better on 2026-11-13. It is still uncommitted in the working tree: crates/acre/examples/key-schemes.acre, the removal of prefix-encoder.acre, the formatter test and the changelog line.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/cd2d1020
notes.text: The figure is at figures/key-schemes.acre in the acre checkout, which .git/info/exclude keeps out of git. Jack wants it refined as the milestone acre-e77413 lands, as a test case for each new feature. Section 4 explains masked keys in eight steps with a bit-level diagram, and all its text follows the deslop rules and the main ASD-STE100 rules. tmp-claude/2026-11-13-key-schemes/model.py checks every key value it shows.
